nodes.title: Important Note
widgets_values:
> BFS Shot Planner — Optional
  >
  > This node was designed to simplify processing longer videos by splitting them into smaller shots. It also provides tools for prompt generation, subject segmentation, masks, cropping, uncropping, reference descriptions, and shot-by-shot
  > configuration.
  >
  > The planner is optional. If you prefer, you can use ComfyUI’s native Load Video nodes and limit the input to a maximum of 15 seconds, using a frame count supported by the model. In that setup, pass the input video through Add Guide instead
  > of the conventional native reference-video conditioning. The body or character reference should still be supplied as an image through the native reference node.
  >
  > One of the planner’s main advantages is its automatic loop: a single workflow run processes every configured shot and performs the swap sequentially. You can also configure the continuity/history window, which passes extra frames from the
  > previous generated shot into the next one to improve motion and visual continuity.
  >
  > Some variation between shots is still expected. This is especially noticeable when the character reference shows only part of the body, because the model may generate unseen clothing or body details differently in each shot. A clear full-
  > body reference generally improves consistency.
  >
  > You can review and edit the character description extracted from the reference image. This also allows you to request details that are not visible in the original reference, such as roller shoes, accessories, clothing changes, or other
  > character features. This feature is still experimental and has not been explored extensively.

The guide video provides the scene and the performance: its background, environment, lighting, camera, framing, body pose, hand and arm movement, head rotation, gaze direction, lip movement and facial expression, frame by frame; only {target} is replaced: their face, hair, body and clothing become <Subject 1>.  summary: [video generation + reference] Replace {target} in the guide video with <Subject 1>, keeping the scene, camera and the complete motion and performance of the guide video.  detailed_description: [Shot 1] <Subject 1> takes the exact place of {target} and moves with the same timing, body pose, gestures, head motion, gaze, speech and facial expressions, while keeping the complete look from <Picture 1>: head, face, skin, hair or fur, body shape and clothing stay stable in every frame, with no trace of the original subject's face, hair or clothing. The background, lighting, colors and camera of the guide video are preserved. Prevent identity drift, clothing changes, texture crawling and flicker.
